notes: replicas: no replicas or scale key in the emailservice block (docker-compose.yml:192-216); its deploy block sets only resources.limits.memory (docker-compose.yml:200-203). Library default, not in these files.
healthcheck: no healthcheck key in docker-compose.yml:192-216. The process is a Sinatra server (email_server.rb:6) and email_server.rb:18-33 defines no health route. No heartbeat or cleanup schedule.
registry, discovery, coordinator: none. No registry or discovery client in the Gemfile (Gemfile:5-12); docker-compose.yml:213-215 depends_on only otelcol.
messaging: none. No Kafka or other messaging client in Gemfile:5-12, and no kafka depends_on in docker-compose.yml:213-215.

syncEdges: none outbound in these files. email_server.rb:39-45 sends mail through Pony with via: :test, not a service call. The inbound route POST /send_order_confirmation (email_server.rb:18) has its caller outside these files.

telemetry destination: docker-compose.yml:210 sets OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_TRACES_ENDPOINT=http://${OTEL_COLLECTOR_HOST}:${OTEL_COLLECTOR_PORT_HTTP}/v1/traces; .env:27 and .env:29 resolve it to otelcol:4318. Only a traces endpoint appears in docker-compose.yml:207-212; no metrics or logs endpoint is set there. OTEL_SERVICE_NAME=emailservice at docker-compose.yml:212.
exporter selection: email_server.rb:14-16 does not name an exporter. Exporter defaults and the batch export interval are library default, not in these files.

telemetry on or off: OTEL_TRACES_EXPORTER, OTEL_METRICS_EXPORTER and OTEL_LOGS_EXPORTER are set for emailservice from OTEL_CANDIDATE_EMAILSERVICE_EXPORTER, and OTEL_SDK_DISABLED from OTEL_CANDIDATE_EMAILSERVICE_DISABLED (compose.candidate-postures.yml:53-58, harness repo). The values of those variables are not in these files.

exportsTelemetryTo.note: Resolves the OTEL_COLLECTOR_HOST reference in docker-compose.yml:210 (OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_TRACES_ENDPOINT); port 4318 at .env:29. Traces only. Active only if the candidate posture variables enable export (see extraction.notes).
